items.title: Caleb Williams: Johnson unclear on return for QB
items.description:
Head coach Ben Johnson wouldn't commit to a return date for Williams (hamstring) after Sunday's loss at Green Bay, Chris Emma of 670TheScore.com reports. "He's on track. We'll see if that's Atlanta or after," Johnson said. "I think it's going to be close."

items.title: Jordan Love: Elite numbers in easy win
items.description:
Love completed 25 of 31 passes for 367 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding one carry for six yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Breaks out for 116 yards, TD
items.description:
Allen rushed 24 times for 116 yards and a touchdown while catching one of four targets for no gain in Sunday's 17-12 win over the Browns.

items.title: Matthew Golden: Eclipses century mark in win
items.description:
Golden secured six of seven targets for 123 yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday. He also returned two punts for 27 yards.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: Bounces back with 104 yards, TD
items.description:
Wilson caught seven of 11 targets for 104 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 17-12 win over the Browns.
